Who said it?

Cost of turnover

Five inputs chain into one rough cost.

  1. A. Headcount100 associatesso you can scale it
  2. B. Turnover rate150%row 6; row 9 gives 124%
  3. C. Early shareabout 2/3row 8, an assumption
  4. D. Pay per associate$40,000$20/hour × 2,000 hours
  5. E. Cost per replacement$4,700 or $8,000low: row 11, mid: 20% of D

The method: headcount × turnover rate gives leavers a year. Leavers × cost per replacement gives the yearly cost.

The Cost Inputs tab holds these sourced inputs. You'll use them to build your own estimate in the next task.

A rough estimate built on older, third-party numbers. Don't present it as Amazon's actual cost.
